Fonts bundled with the tech-logo-generator skill (used to outline the wordmark and the binary texture; the logos contain
paths, not the font files).

Poppins (Light, Regular, Bold, ExtraBold)
  Copyright 2020 The Poppins Project Authors (https://github.com/itfoundry/Poppins)
JetBrains Mono (Bold)
  Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)

Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org), which allows use,
embedding, outlining and redistribution, including in logos and commercial products. The fonts may not be sold on their own.
Obtained from the npm packages @expo-google-fonts/poppins and @expo-google-fonts/jetbrains-mono.
